title: Audit installed Ollama models for real native tool calling
description: Enumerate locally installed Ollama models, test only models advertising tools capability against the same write_probe schema, record whether message.tool_calls is actually returned, and select the first structured-tool winner without changing OpenClaw configuration.
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';if(-not(Test-Path $ep)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_MISSING'};$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 30;$models=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{[string]$_.name}|Where-Object{$_}|Sort-Object -Unique);if($models.Count -eq 0){throw 'NO_LOCAL_OLLAMA_MODELS'};Write-Output ('V443_057L_MODELS='+($models -join ','));$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$rows=@();foreach($model in $models){$caps=@();$showError=$null;try{$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{model=$model}|ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 30;$caps=@($show.capabilities)}catch{$showError=$_.Exception.Message};$supportsTools=($caps -contains 'tools');$toolCount=0;$props=@();$content='';$chatError=$null;if($supportsTools){try{$body=@{model=$model;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='system';content='You are a tool-using agent. When a matching tool is available, call it instead of answering with JSON or prose.'},@{role='user';content='Use write_probe with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/native-tool-audit.txt and content NATIVE_TOOL_OK. Do not answer in prose.'});tools=@($tool);options=@{temperature=0}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 300;$msg=$resp.message;if($null -ne $msg){$props=@($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name)};$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};$toolCount=$tc.Count;if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'content')){$content=[string]$msg.content}}catch{$chatError=$_.Exception.Message}};$structured=($toolCount -gt 0);$preview=($content -replace '[
]+',' ');if($preview.Length -gt 300){$preview=$preview.Substring(0,300)};$row=[pscustomobject]@{model=$model;capabilities=$caps;supportsTools=$supportsTools;messageProperties=$props;toolCallCount=$toolCount;structured=$structured;contentPreview=$preview;showError=$showError;chatError=$chatError};$rows+=,$row;Write-Output ('V443_057L_MODEL='+$model+' tools='+$supportsTools+' structured='+$structured+' toolCalls='+$toolCount)};$winner=@($rows|Where-Object{$_.structured}|Select-Object -First 1);$winnerName=if($winner.Count -gt 0){[string]$winner[0].model}else{''};$artifact=Join-Path $root 'native-tool-model-audit.json';[pscustomobject]@{testedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');endpoint=$base;models=$rows;winner=$winnerName;structuredWinnerFound=(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($winnerName))}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20|Set-Content $artifact -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V443_057L_WINNER='+$winnerName);Write-Output ('V443_057L_ARTIFACT='+$artifact);Write-Output 'V443_057L_CAPTURE=PASS'
